newsitem.title: USA: Cintas and new subs earned $7 mln in June.
newsitem.headline: Cintas and new subs earned $7 mln in June.

text.p: Cintas Corp said Wednesday the company and its recent acquisitions earned $7 million, or $0.14 a share, on sales of $75 million, in the month of June.
The company said the results include the sales and earnings of companies it bought since May 31.
Treasurer Karen Carnahan said in an interview the acquisitions --the biggest was G&J Cleanroom of Greenville, S.C.-- contributed little to Cintas' results.
"They're minor in relation to our whole company," she said. She added the Securities and Exchange Commission's rules on pooling of interests required the company to posts its June sales and earnings.

Cintas posted a $25.9 million net, or $0.54 a share, on revenues of $228.6 million in the quarter ended May 31. This compared with a $21.5 million net, or $0.46 a share, on revenues of $194.4 milion the year before.
Its stock hit a 52-week high of 70-3/4 Wednesday, but traded at 70, up 1/4 in the afternoon.
